notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
17 new levels have been added to the built in game's levels bring the total to 50, a ~33% increase. 

Additionally more achievements have been made accessible.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Workshop Implementation[/h1]

It now easier to make your levels and share them with your friends and the world. Once you make a level, the ability to share it is displayed next to the PLAY button on your custom levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369304/7b955139d66a9d6e687c8c4b14b3c0410f34c571.jpg[/img]

By subscribing to a level it will appear the next time you launch Laser Burst. You can find these levels over at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1475000/workshop/]Laser Burst Workshop[/url].

[h1]VSync[/h1]

Short for vertical sync, VSync is the graphics technology responsible for synchronizing the frame rate of a game to the refresh rate of a monitor. I got a request in the discussions area to add it and so I did.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369304/9526b20398abfad32ccc20ab0e1292e9d9732d92.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]

I just wanted to put this here. I appreciate each and every one of you who purchased Laser Burst. I hope that you have and will continue enjoying it.

Jesse @ Never Mind Games

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: Got a report of a graphics card spinning up without a maximum FPS set by the application and potentially when left running could cause an issue. Went in a capped the FPS to 300 frames which shouldn't be "downgrade" to anyone's graphic fidelity.

notes.title: Burst-ing at the seams
notes.content:
The year of 2020 was long and trying for so many people including myself. Despite that fact I'm extremely proud and excited that despite everything I managed to work on and complete Laser Burst as my first independently developed video game. I hope each and every person who gives it a try enjoys the puzzles, the music, and the energy that I put into it. 

<3
Jesse @ Never Mind Games
